mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reports (reporter_id, target_type, target_id, reason, detail, status, created_at) VALUES (#{reporterId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{detail}, 'PENDING', NOW())
mapper.sql: r.report_id, r.reporter_id, CASE WHEN ru.status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE ru.nickname END AS reporter_nickname, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reason, r.detail, r.status, r.created_at, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'POST' THEN (SELECT title FROM posts WHERE post_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT LEFT(content, 80) FROM comments WHERE comment_id = r.target_id) ELSE ( SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE nickname END FROM users WHERE user_id = r.target_id ) END AS target_label, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'POST' THEN (SELECT author_id FROM posts WHERE post_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT author_id FROM comments WHERE comment_id = r.target_id) ELSE r.target_id END AS target_author_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reports r JOIN users ru ON ru.user_id = r.reporter_id WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports WHERE status IN ('RESOLVED', 'REJECTED')

SELECT r.report_id AS log_id, CASE WHEN u.status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE u.nickname END AS admin_nickname, COALESCE(r.process_note, '') AS summary, r.process_note AS note, r.processed_at AS created_at, r.status, r.target_type, r.target_id, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'POST' THEN (SELECT title FROM posts WHERE post_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT LEFT(content, 80) FROM comments WHERE comment_id = r.target_id) ELSE ( SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE nickname END FROM users WHERE user_id = r.target_id ) END AS target_label, r.reason, r.detail, CASE WHEN reporter.status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE reporter.nickname END AS reporter_nickname, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'POST' THEN ( SELECT CASE WHEN author.status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE author.nickname END FROM posts p JOIN users author ON author.user_id = p.author_id WHERE p.post_id = r.target_id ) WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN ( SELECT CASE WHEN author.status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE author.nickname END FROM comments c JOIN users author ON author.user_id = c.author_id WHERE c.comment_id = r.target_id ) ELSE ( SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE nickname END FROM users WHERE user_id = r.target_id ) END AS target_nickname, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'POST' THEN ( SELECT author.status FROM posts p JOIN users author ON author.user_id = p.author_id WHERE p.post_id = r.target_id ) WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN ( SELECT author.status FROM comments c JOIN users author ON author.user_id = c.author_id WHERE c.comment_id = r.target_id ) ELSE (SELECT status FROM users WHERE user_id = r.target_id) END AS target_status FROM reports r JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.processed_by JOIN users reporter ON reporter.user_id = r.reporter_id WHERE r.status IN ('RESOLVED', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY r.processed_at DESC, r.report_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET status = #{status}, processed_by = #{adminId}, process_note = #{note}, processed_at = NOW() WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'REVIEWING')
